_comment: Digital garden. `include` folder-globs the safe feature areas (Components / Guides / Integrations) so new notes there publish automatically — that is the self-updating garden. `includeFiles` adds individual picks (e.g. one architecture review). Sensitive areas (Security, Audits, Future/Vision drafts, sessions, errors, personal/financial) are excluded and every note is content-scanned + length-filtered. Run `npm run sync:notes`, then commit content/notes/.
